officialRelatedIssue.title: WebKit278455: Custom Highlight rendering with disabled text selection
officialRelatedIssue.relevance: The official tracker contains a report of WebKit omitting Custom Highlight styling on nonselectable text, with a selection-style change affecting its reproduction. This supports investigating text selectability.
officialRelatedIssue.limit: It does not establish this precise installed engine build, explain the misplaced JSON brace by itself, or prove the unique historical cause of all prior Farfold failures.

result.controlledFinding: With r1 JavaScript held byte-identical, the scoped selectable-text CSS intervention removes the observed wrong paint and preserves the shown first/next/manual-fold/wrap/reverse/close behavior in this synthetic production WebKit sample.
result.uncovered: Actual formal installation and original owned counterexample after replacement; other P12 loaded-history/attachment/live-thread/Unicode/platform paths remain limited to their separately recorded coverage.
